question: Where must regulatory signs be installed, and what nighttime-visibility requirement applies?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Regulatory signs must be installed at or near the location where the regulations they convey actually apply, and they must be designed and installed to provide adequate visibility and legibility. For nighttime visibility, regulatory signs must be either retroreflective or illuminated, as shown in the visual evidence of Section 2B.01 (Paragraph 03, referencing Section 2A.21). Standards (mandatory): - "Regulatory signs shall be installed at or near where the regulations apply. The signs shall clearly indicate the requirements imposed by the regulations and shall be designed and installed to provide adequate visibility and legibility in order to obtain compliance." - "Regulatory signs shall be used to inform road users of selected traffic laws or regulations and to indicate the applicability of the legal requirements." - "All regulatory and warning signs installed on roads and streets open to public travel within recreational and cultural interest areas shall comply with the requirements elsewhere in this Manual." - Per the visible text of Section 2B.01 Paragraph 03: "Regulatory signs shall be retroreflective or illuminated (see Section 2A.21)." Visual evidence: - [Image 4] shows Section 2B.01 "Application of Regulatory Signs," including the Standard provision (Paragraph 03) stating that regulatory signs shall be retroreflective or illuminated, with a cross-reference to Section 2A.21. - [Image 1] shows Table 2A-4, "Retroreflection of Sign Elements," listing the means of retroreflection (e.g., prismatic reflector "buttons," smooth sealed outer surface materials) and the sign elements they apply to (symbol, word message, border), supporting how the retroreflectivity requirement is satisfied. - [Image 2] shows the table of contents confirming Section 2A.21 "Retroreflection and Illumination" and Section 2A.22 "Maintaining Minimum Retroreflectivity," the provisions cross-referenced by the regulatory sign visibility requirement. Citations: - Section 2B.01 Standard §2 (p.67) - Section 2B.01 Standard §1 (p.67) - Section 2M.03 Standard §1 (p.520) - Table 2A-4 (p.62) - Page 108 - Page 7
gold_answer: They must be installed at or near the location where the regulation applies, clearly state the requirement, and provide adequate visibility and legibility. They must be retroreflective or illuminated.
